## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Graphs — derived functions for IGraph
//
// Bodies for the `IGraph` interface declared in `graphs.concepts.plato`: a
// vertex-and-edge structure exposing VertexCount, EdgeCount and the
// directedness flag. The helpers are the counting summaries those three members
// support — the handshake-lemma degree sum, the simple-graph edge ceiling,
// completeness, average degree and edge density. Pure expressions only; all
// inputs are immutable and evaluation is side-effect free.

library Graphs
{
    //==
    // # IGraph
    //
    // A vertex-and-edge structure exposing VertexCount, EdgeCount, and the
    // directedness flag. Helpers include the handshake-lemma degree sum and the
    // completeness test.

    // True when the graph is undirected.
    IsUndirected(self: IGraph): Boolean
        => self.IsDirected.Not;

    // True when the graph has no vertices.
    IsEmpty(self: IGraph): Boolean
        => self.VertexCount == 0;

    // True when the graph has at least one vertex.
    IsNotEmpty(self: IGraph): Boolean
        => self.VertexCount > 0;

    // True when the graph has at least one edge.
    HasEdges(self: IGraph): Boolean
        => self.EdgeCount > 0;

    // The sum of all vertex degrees. By the handshake lemma this is twice the
    // edge count, whether the graph is directed (in-degree plus out-degree) or
    // undirected (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Handshaking_lemma).
    DegreeSum(self: IGraph): Integer
        => self.EdgeCount * 2;

    // The maximum number of simple edges the graph could hold: V*(V-1) directed,
    // V*(V-1)/2 undirected (no self-loops, no parallel edges).
    MaxPossibleEdges(self: IGraph): Integer
        => self.IsDirected
            ? self.VertexCount * (self.VertexCount - 1)
            : self.VertexCount * (self.VertexCount - 1) / 2;

    // True when the graph holds every possible simple edge. Precondition: the
    // graph is simple (no self-loops or parallel edges)
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Complete_graph).
    IsComplete(self: IGraph): Boolean
        => self.EdgeCount == self.MaxPossibleEdges;

    // The average vertex degree: the degree sum (2E) over the vertex count, as a
    // Number via Integer.ToNumber. Precondition: the graph is non-empty.
    AverageDegree(self: IGraph): Number
        => self.DegreeSum.ToNumber / self.VertexCount.ToNumber;

    // The edge density: actual edges over the maximum possible simple edges, in
    // [0, 1]. Precondition: the graph has at least two vertices (MaxPossibleEdges > 0)
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dense_graph).
    EdgeDensity(self: IGraph): Number
        => self.EdgeCount.ToNumber / self.MaxPossibleEdges.ToNumber;

    // The number of stored edges.
    EdgeCount(self: Graph): Integer
        => self.Edges.Count;

    // True when edges carry a direction.
    IsDirected(self: Graph): Boolean
        => self.Directed;

    // The number of stored weighted edges.
    EdgeCount(self: WeightedGraph): Integer
        => self.Edges.Count;

    // True when edges carry a direction.
    IsDirected(self: WeightedGraph): Boolean
        => self.Directed;

    //==
    // # GraphEdge

    // Both endpoints participate in the digest.
    Hash(self: GraphEdge): Integer
        => self.Source.Hash * 31 + self.Target.Hash;
}
```
